scope: Public primary metadata, small standalone text manifests, repository file listings, and HEAD requests only; no images or image-bearing parquet/tar downloaded.
units: Bytes are exact upstream metadata; GB=10^9 bytes, GiB=2^30 bytes. Tar sizes are archive downloads, not decoded pixel-memory sizes.

counts.method: direct parse of official standalone descriptions manifest

DOCCI.download_layout: Images and descriptions are hosted separately by Google Cloud Storage; HF repo itself only contains README/loading code.
DOCCI.excluded_aar_reason: DOCCI-AAR has no captions; do not add its image count to usable image-caption pairs.
DOCCI.access: Anonymous public GCS HEAD and annotation GET succeeded; HF API reports ungated.

counts.method: HF Dataset Viewer complete size response, partial=false; row counts are not unique-image deduplication
counts.cross_config_overlap: Expected; do not add the 102025 and 1246901 rows as a unique-image total.

ShareGPT4V.download_layout: Caption JSONs contain image paths; no image payloads included in this HF repo.

source_images.storage_caveat: 46.69 GB is only two whole source archives, not full ShareGPT4V storage and not the minimum bytes for selected records. SAM/web/TextCaps storage remains unmeasured. Full source archives contain unused images.

ShareGPT4V.access: Caption repository API is ungated and public. Image access and licenses follow each upstream source; the author documentation marks the web-image bundle academic-only.
ShareGPT4V.license_caveat: CC BY-NC 4.0 is the dataset-card declaration, not a replacement for underlying source-image licenses.

counts.advertised_count_exactness: Rounded advertised collection size; actual tar image membership was not enumerated.
counts.viewer_7103_warning: HF viewer reports 7103 one-column text rows; these match geneval_train.txt lines. This is not the number of image-caption pairs in the 11 tar archives.
counts.splits: Released as instruction-tuning data; no separate held-out split described by the card. Card says Geneval component has no overlap with test set.

BLIP3o_60K.download_layout: WebDataset tar files include images and captions; standalone txt files are prompts and do not provide verified image filename mapping.
BLIP3o_60K.access: Anonymous metadata/text downloads succeeded; HF API ungated/public.
BLIP3o_60K.license_caveat: Apache-2.0 is the HF card declaration. Images are GPT-4o-distilled; upstream source/material terms require separate consideration.

BLIP3o_pretraining.download_layout: Images and captions included in WebDataset tar archives; read without extraction if desired.
BLIP3o_pretraining.count_caveat: Card values are advertised rounded counts; viewer estimates are extrapolated from partial conversion. Neither proves unique images or cross-dataset non-overlap.

BLIP3o_pretraining.download_layout: Images and captions included in WebDataset tar archives; read without extraction if desired.
BLIP3o_pretraining.count_caveat: Card values are advertised rounded counts; viewer estimates are extrapolated from partial conversion. Neither proves unique images or cross-dataset non-overlap.

recommended_initial_subset.estimate_basis: 9647 verified DOCCI train records plus advertised approximately 60000 BLIP3o images; not deduplicated across datasets.
recommended_initial_subset.space_note: Approximately 116 GB of source archives including all DOCCI splits. Plan at least 130 GB if reading BLIP tars directly; allow additional space for DOCCI extraction, caches, or retained extracted copies. Extracted byte totals were not measured.
recommended_initial_subset.reason: DOCCI provides small, directly verified human-written captions; BLIP3o-60k supplies task-specific generation data with hosted image archives. ShareGPT4V requires assembling images from multiple separate sources.

known_retrieval_limitations: DOCCI viewer size endpoint returns HTTP 501 because the dataset uses a loading script; official manifest provided exact counts.
COCO HTTPS HEAD failed certificate hostname validation; the authors linked HTTP URL returned valid headers. No certificate-validation bypass was used.
BLIP3o pretraining tree pagination was followed completely; the first 1000-file page alone underestimates storage.
archive_note: Compact tracked audit; detailed file inventories and raw HTTP/API evidence remain in the verified metadata bundle on Aurora.
